query_analysis.original_query: I need to develop a predictive model for eutectic salt formation in our deep eutectic solvent-based extraction process for rare earth elements. Can you help me characterize the thermodynamic boundaries?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a predictive thermodynamic model to characterize and understand eutectic salt formation in our deep eutectic solvent-based extraction process for rare earth elements, aiming to identify thermodynamic boundaries to optimize extraction efficiency.
query_analysis.primary_domain: Thermodynamics of Deep Eutectic Solvent Extraction

communication_strategy.information_flow: Thermodynamic data and models to Mathematical Solver; model predictions shared with Separation Technologist for process integration
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative model development and validation through collaborative analysis

clarification_questions: What are the specific components and compositions in your deep eutectic solvent system?
What operating conditions (temperature, pressure) are you working with?
Do you have any existing experimental data on eutectic salt formation in your system?
